name: eval2: the window wall agrees with the sofa wall (the polish walk): the cushions at the far end, the room's case open and shut.

cases.prompt: Attached picture 1 is finished and approved. Redraw it as the same picture, keeping absolutely everything exactly as it is, the same objects in the same places at the same sizes, the same colours, light and drawing style, except for this one change: at the left edge, on the end of the grey sofa nearest the window, the two cushions (green and world map) are gone, because they sit at the sofa's far end, out of this view; and the small open case there is replaced by the room's own suitcase from attached picture 2: the same dark navy hard case with its lid standing open upright, lying flat on the seat, seen from its short end, so its side panel and the open lid's grey lining show and its handle is on the long side facing into the room. Drawn from the same eye level as the rest of the room, the same size it would be on that seat. Nothing else changes anywhere. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.
cases.note: Polish walk: m2 agreed with m3 (cushions at the far end; the room's open case)
